'''Mudhorns''' were large, horned, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] whose main habitat was the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. Mudhorns had [[Color/Legends|grey]] skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|wool]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a horn, and spikes along their backs.<ref name="Desert Mudhorn" /> Small hairless mudhorns only had grey skin and a horn.<ref name="Hairless Mudhorn">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=item|Hairless Mudhorn}}</ref>

The mudhorn was an extremely territorial creature by nature and it was considered hard to domesticate them; only expert handlers were able to do it.<ref name="Desert Mudhorn" /> By [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> mudhorns had been domesticated and used as riding animals<ref name="Desert Mudhorn" /> and pet companions.<ref name="Hairless Mudhorn" /> Juvenile mudhorns were known as "mudpups."<ref name="Mudpups">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240529|text=The Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival Event has come to SWTOR!}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mudhorns first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity as a purchasable mount in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion of [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Desert Mudhorn" /> specifically Update 6.1.4 released in [[2020]].<ref name="Cartel Market">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20201020-0|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 6.1.4}}</ref> The [[mudhorn]] was originally introduced in the new [[canon]] continuity in<ref name="Chapter 2">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 2: The Child}}</ref> the second episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season One|first season]]<ref name="Insider201">{{InsiderCite|201|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season One Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One Companion}}</ref> of the television series [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']], "[[Chapter 2: The Child]],"<ref name="Chapter 2" /> which aired on [[November 15]], [[2019]].<ref name="Insider201" />

A promotional picture for the "Desert Mudhorn Mount" item on the game's [https://www.swtor.com official website] features an individual with [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] riding a mudhorn in the deserts of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Cartel Market">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20201020-0|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 6.1.4}}</ref>
